jobs.title: Security Officer - Full Time Hotel Patrol
jobs.description:
Security Officer - Full Time Hotel Patrol

Overview


Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description


As a Security Officer - Full Time Hotel Patrol in San Antonio, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Hotels & Resorts, and more. As a Patrol Unarmed Officer at a hotel and resort location, you will monitor and patrol assigned areas, maintain a visible presence to help deter incidents, and provide welcoming customer service to guests and staff. You will communicate clearly, respond to security-related concerns, and support a positive environment. Join Allied Universal, where agility, reliability, innovation, teamwork, and integrity guide our people-first culture.

Position Type: Full Time

Pay Rate: $15.67 / Hour

Job Schedule:

Day
Time

Wed
10:00 PM - 06:00 AM

Thur
10:00 PM - 06:00 AM

10:00 PM - 06:00 AM

What You'll Do:

  • Provide exceptional customer service to guests, visitors, and staff while carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and emergency response activities at a hotel and resort location.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols of guest areas, entrances, parking areas, amenities, and the property perimeter to help deter unauthorized activity and identify potential concerns.
  • Respond to incidents, guest concerns, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, following established reporting and escalation procedures.
  • Monitor access points and observe activity throughout the property, reporting unusual conditions, maintenance concerns, and policy violations to appropriate personnel.
  • Complete accurate activity logs, incident reports, and shift documentation in accordance with Allied Universal and site-specific requirements.

Minimum Requirements:

  • A Guard Card or license is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us:

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.


Closing


Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

  • Valid state driver’s license

  • Professional demeanor and appearance

  • Strong communication skills (verbal and written)

jobs.title: Security Officer (Full-Time)
jobs.description:
Organization- Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort and Spa

Summary

Schedule Requirements: Must be available to work a flexible schedule during the week, including weekends and holidays.

Role

The Security Officer is responsible for the oversight of the safety and security of the hotel guests and employees. This person will follow safety and security standards and complete incident reports as required.

Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Ensure the overall safety and security of the hotel guests, Colleagues and hotel premises
  • Act as a member of the Emergency Response Team, responding in cases of fire, accident, safety concerns and calls for medical assistance
  • Investigate and report any violations to law or hotel policy
  • Provide First Aid and C.P.R. as required
  • Conduct regular floor patrols, cash counts and crowd control
  • Maintain computer records of all actions in a Daily Activity Report
  • Assist guests regarding hotel facilities in an informative and helpful way

About Our Resort

Nestled across 300 scenic acres in the heart of Texas Hill Country, Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort & Villas is San Antonio's premier luxury resort destination, where authentic Texas hospitality meets world-class amenities and unforgettable experiences.

Fresh off a multi-million-dollar transformation, our award-winning resort features beautifully redesigned guest rooms, an expanded collection of luxury villas, enhanced dining experiences, revitalized meeting and event spaces, and exciting new recreation offerings designed to elevate every guest stay.

Guests can unwind at our full-service Windflower Spa, enjoy 27 holes of championship golf, float along our signature lazy river, and experience the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure that has made us a leading destination for leisure travelers, corporate groups, weddings, and special events. Our unique event venues include the stunning Rancher Hall Event Barn, offering an authentic Texas backdrop for memorable celebrations and gatherings.

Recognized as the #1 Resort in San Antonio by TripAdvisor and consistently ranked among the top resorts in Texas, Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort & Villas continues to set the standard for exceptional guest experiences.

As we enter an exciting new era of growth, innovation, and elevated luxury, we are seeking passionate hospitality professionals who are inspired to lead, create meaningful connections, and help shape the future of one of Texas' most celebrated resort destinations. Here, you'll find more than a career—you'll find opportunities to grow, develop, and make a lasting impact while working alongside a team that truly cares for one another and our guests.

Why Join Us?

At Hyatt, we prioritize creating a culture where colleagues feel like family. Since 1957, we've grown into one of the world's leading hospitality brands by valuing our people. We transform jobs into fulfilling careers, turning guest stays into unforgettable journeys, and fostering an environment where belonging and care thrive.

Qualifications

  • A true desire to satisfy the needs of others in a fast paced environment
  • Refined verbal and written communication skills to provide guests and colleagues elevated service
  • Ability to stand for long periods of time and walk moderate distances
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule, including weekends and holidays
  • Proficient in basic computer skills
  • Previous security experience preferred

Benefits & Perks

  • Health, dental and vision benefits
  • Discounted & complimentary hotel room nights
  • Paid time off
  • Retirement savings plan
  • Employee stock option plan
  • Enjoy complimentary meals in our colleague café
  • Tuition reimbursement, up to $1,000 a year
  • Excellent training and professional development
  • Opportunities to work around the world with Hyatt Hotels and Resorts

About The Hiring Process

We are excited that you have chosen to express interest in joining Hyatt Hotels and Resorts. We will be sure to take a look at your application and get back to you within a week of your submission. Thank you for your patience while we do so.

All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required, as well as a completed background check.

jobs.title: Security Agent - Full-Time
jobs.description:
Join a Global Leader in Aviation Security!

$17.00 per hour

Medical, dental & vision insurance available! 401K with company matching! Paid vacation & holidays!

ACTS-Aviation Security Inc. has an immediate opening for an Aviation Security Agent at the San Antonio Airport in San Antonio, TX to carry out aviation security functions as prescribed by Transportation Security Administration rules and regulations.

Established in 2001, ACTS-Aviation Security has grown to become one of the leading providers of security solutions to the US aviation market. ACTS-Aviation Security, Inc. is a wholly owned subsidiary of the international aviation security company ICTS Europe and specializes in the provision of aviation-related security solutions and services; primarily focused on catering inspection. With corporate office in Chicago, and operational centers at more than 30 airports across the United States, ACTS provides nationwide coverage. As an ICTS Europe subsidiary, ACTS offers unmatched experience, expertise, quality and innovation. ACTS Aviation Security Agents are proud of their role in aviation security and have the opportunity for advancement – the ideal place to build a career in aviation security.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Inspects airline catering equipment and checks for any unauthorized items in accordance with Transportation Security Administration security rules and regulations.
  • May be required to perform aircraft monitoring according to airline carrier security specifications.
  • Performs all other duties as assigned by management.
  • Reports to Operations Supervisor or Operations Manager, depending on size of unit.
  • Activities overseen by Lead or Senior Lead, depending on size of unit.

Education:

High school diploma or GED

Requirements:

  • New employees are required to complete an FBI Criminal History Records Check (SIDA Badge) and a confirmed 10-year background check (10 year listed; 5 year verified)
  • Not have been convicted of any of the listed FAA/TSA Disqualifying Crimes;
  • Ability to bend, push, and lift up to 30 pounds on a regular basis in order to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Must be at least 18 years old.
  • Hold a valid U.S. driver’s license
  • Must be willing to work in cold temperatures, as it is a requirement for this role.

Communication Skills:

Proficient written and oral communication skills in English.

Certificates, Licenses and Registrations:

None.

Travel:

None

Environmental Requirements:

Works non standard work hours, evenings, weekends, holidays.

Demonstrated Competencies to be Successful in the Position:

  • Security Mindset – take pride in keeping the skies safe and the flights secure
  • Trust - keeping promises and speaking the truth.
  • Customer Focused - the willingness to listen and the duty to act – promptly and appropriately.
  • Team Spirit - integrity, experience, collaboration and open communication.
  • Innovation – creativity, seeking new ideas, continuous improvement though anticipating change and adapting to it.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Candidates will be required to go through pre-employment drug screen, criminal check and/or airport fingerprinting.

ACTS is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Full Time Unarmed - Mobile Patrol in San Antonio, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Hotels & Resorts, and more. As an Unarmed Security Officer at a premier hospitality location, you will conduct routine patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents, and provide exceptional customer service to guests and staff. This driving position requires a valid driver's license in accordance with Allied Universal driver policy requirements. Join an agile, reliable, and innovative team that puts people first, works together, and acts with integrity.

Position Type: Full Time

 Pay Rate: $18.54 / Hour

  • Monitor access points and visitor activity in accordance with site-specific procedures, directing guests and vendors as appropriate.

jobs.title: Full Time Temporary Security Officers, must be licensed
jobs.description:
Job Skills / Requirements
This Security Officer position you will be monitoring and patrolling the assigned client site. Security Officer helps maintain a safe and secure environment by actively monitoring and patrolling the site premises.
Schedule:
Pay Rate: $18.00
We have an IMMEDIATE NEED and are looking for individuals to begin quickly.

We are seeking officers who are ready to break the common misconception of what we provide and can align themselves with our vision.
We will provide you with the training and everything you need for a great introduction to a career in the security industry.

The scope of work and required duties are outlined as follows and vary by site:
1- Provide security presence. Verify access clearance for approved motorists, guests, contract workers, and delivery services. Call appropriate contacts for access approval when necessary and record entry in site logs.
2- Patrol designated areas according to assigned schedule. Observe and report activity while on duty.
3- Visitor and guest access control at business locations. Create access badges, conduct hourly interior patrols, and monitor CCTV systems.
4- Prepare and send hourly and/or daily legible security reports using assigned smart phones and tablets.
5- Security officers with a valid and active driver’s license may be asked to operate company vehicles at various locations as part of their scope of work.
Schedules vary from 1st, 2nd, and 3rd shift on weekdays, weekends and/or a combination of both. Hours vary from 8-hour shifts to 12-hour shifts.
Once assigned, security officers are expected to complete the assigned shift.
Security officers are expected to be punctual, courteous, professional in appearance, and adhere to the guidelines of the assigned site and chain of command.

What Will You Need as a Level 2 Security Officer at North America Security?
-High School Diploma (or GED or High School Equivalence Certificate)
-Must be a minimum of 18 years of age
-Must be able to successfully pass a criminal background screening amp; drug screening
-Must be authorized to work in the United States
-Must have a reliable method of communication and transportation
-Applicants must be able to handle themselves professionally in a social setting and/or resident community
-Applicants must be able to handle difficult situations professionally and be willing to work with supervisors when necessary
-Ability to utilize android phones, data entry software, printer/scanner/copier/fax

Equal Employment Opportunity
It is the policy of North America Security Services to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. North America Security Services prohibits and will not tolerate any such discrimination or harassment.

We are licensed by the State of Texas (TXPSB# C19369, C19369A, C19369B)

High School Diploma / GED

Texas Non-Commissioned Security Officer (Level 2)
I am eligible to be licensed as a security officer in the State of Texas
Additional Information / Benefits
Benefits: Medical Insurance, Life Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Special Incentive Plans, Gym Membership Discount
This job reports to the Operations Manager
This is a Full-Time position.
Relocation is not provided
